bugs.summary: [Wizard] "Switch the analysis type?" dialog has no close (X) icon
bugs.description: The confirmation dialog shown when the user changes the analysis type in the wizard has no close (X) icon. The Figma design of this dialog (frame 0.3, GEO-1209 page) shows a close icon at the top right, next to the title.
steps: Open the GEO dashboard and click New Analysis.
On the Analysis Type step, select a type and continue, then fill the next step (topic or brand, country).
Go back to the Analysis Type step and select the other type.
Observe the "Switch the analysis type?" dialog.
bugs.expected: The dialog shows a close (X) icon at the top right, as in Figma frame 0.3 (https://www.figma.com/design/xctSRqtM653zRS7QY3KMm0/Measure---GEO-Module?node-id=16737-11); closing it keeps the current setup, like Cancel. (Source: Figma design, to confirm.)
bugs.actual: The dialog only has Cancel and Switch type; there is no close (X) icon.
bugs.environment: staging, organisation QA-GEO, en-GB, observed in run 22102026-1134 (TC-GEO-1241-008)

attachments.caption: Staging: no close icon where Figma has one (framed area)
